reasoning: This question asks whether the EM corporate bond spread will increase over a one-week period (Oct 11-18, 2026). Credit spreads are inherently volatile and can move in either direction based on risk sentiment, economic data, and global events. Without specific information about market conditions in October 2026, I must rely on base rates. Historically, weekly spread changes are roughly symmetric with slight mean-reversion tendencies. Over any given week, spreads have approximately equal probability of widening or tightening. Given no directional bias and the short timeframe, I estimate close to 50%.
